name: contact-us

frames.best_why: Both columns are fully visible at rest: the whole form and the globe card with its copy.

tagline: Pink-lit contact form beside a spinning globe card.
summary: A two-column contact block: a sparkle-dusted Contact Us form with name, email and message fields on the left, and a rose gradient card with a slowly turning globe on the right.
appearance: A wide rounded dark container split in two. The left has a bold Contact Us heading with pink italic Us and sparkles, name and email inputs, a tall message box and a rose Send Message button. The right is a rose panel with the line Presenting you with the best UI possible over a dark globe.
behaviour: The form and pink card rise and fade in as the section enters view. The globe turns continuously, fields take focus and text, and Send shows a spinner, then Message Sent! with a tick while the fields clear.
demo_content: Heading Contact Us; card reads Presenting you with the best UI possible; fields say Enter your name, email and message.
search_phrases: get in touch with a globe
send a message with spinning earth
use_when: A product landing page wants an inviting contact form paired with a decorative globe and a strong brand colour.
avoid_when: A restrained corporate site: the vivid rose card and sparkles dominate the form and fight neutral palettes.
customise: Heading, card copy, placeholders and submit behaviour are written into the component; the rose colours, particle count and globe colours are set in the source.
weight_why: A continuously spinning globe plus hundreds of particles and a scroll-in animation.

a11y.note: Fields are labelled and keyboard usable, but the globe and particle loops ignore reduced motion and the sparkles carry no meaning.

issues: The pink sparkle particles cross the heading and slightly obscure the word Contact.
polish_why: Vivid, cohesive brand block with a real submission flow; the busy sparkles and dense form are minor.
title: Contact Us
